description: Adapter class for displaying a list of categories in a RecyclerView, including view holder implementation and item click handling.

classes.name: CategoriesAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying categories, handling item clicks and long clicks.

classes.name: CategoriesAdapter.CatVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for category items, holding references to UI components.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the internal category list with new data and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder for a category item.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of category items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds category data to the view holder for the given position.
